newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Mozambique sees record cereal crops in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Mozambique sees record cereal crops in 1997.

text.p: Mozambique can expect a record cereal harvest for the second year running, a United Nations expert told Reuters on Tuesday.

"Last year we had 1.37 million tonnes and in 1997 we will have not less than 1.50 million tonnes of maize, millet, sorghum and rice," said Antonio Olivares, chief technical adviser to the Ministry of Agriculture's early warning system in Maputo.
"It's going to be better. The weather conditions in the whole country are good," said Olivares, who works for the UN Food and Agricultural Organisation (FAO).
Last year the harvest was limited by serious flooding.
"If we don't have floods this year you can add another 100,000 tonnes to the figure," Olivares said.
